C0147.title: Xiangtan Police Crack Case Involving Stolen Online Accounts Sold for Profit
keywords: Ministry of Public Security typical case
C0147.summary: In March 2025, China's Ministry of Public Security announced ten typical cases from its campaign against crimes involving citizens' personal information, including one Hunan case. The notice reflects the public security authorities' focus on cracking down on personal-information crimes and highlights that personal information and online accounts can form black-gray-market risk chains through illegal acquisition, resale, use, and monetization. Platforms should watch for abnormal account logins, benefit-claim lures, and account-resale clues, and correlate short-video inducement, game-benefit claims, bulk login devices, and account-trading channels to reduce the risk that account assets are harvested in bulk and monetized externally.
